_meta.what: per-variant Evo 2-40B scores for the 20,000-variant pig cis-eQTL panel (5,000 fine-mapped causal, 15,000 within-eGene controls)

columns.gene_id: the eGene the control is drawn within
columns.label: 1 = causal (PIP >= 0.9), 0 = control (PIP <= 0.001)

_meta.orientation: ASSERTED, NOT INFERRED. Use the column as deposited: roc_auc_score(label, evo2_40b_score) = 0.4875, the published 0.488. Negating it returns 0.5125, which is 1 minus the same number and would turn a null into a positive result. This arm is a null and must stay one.
_meta.readout: 1,001-bp single-position variant delta; this panel was never scored at 8,192 bp
_meta.why_deposited: This arm carries the paper's central negative result, and its per-variant scores let a reader check it.
